'''Brett Nottingham''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2000 BayCon tournament]] on 27 May 2000 with [[You Can Either Profit By This... / Or Be Destroyed|Profit]], according to Clayton Atkin's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d829">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-06-04-baycon-2000-5-27d829/ baycon-2000-5-27], DeckTech (Clayton "TheDohMan" Atkin, 4 June 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-06-04-baycon-2000-5-27d829/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
